## Teaching points

1. A unilateral effusion with weight loss needs investigation; do not label it malignant before evidence is available.
2. Ultrasound guides procedural planning, while fluid analysis and further imaging help establish the cause.
3. Sampling and drainage are receiving-team plans here; neither is represented as an already completed ED procedure.
